body:
Existing P0-12 next repair segment; preserve/finish your current cb0f89b timeline correction at its safe boundary, then address this within the same task. No restart, duplicate task, owner/schema change or added provider/device scope.

Independent QA delivered e26523ef5e42e8c0e17f10ae8daea597eae662c9: read docs/verification/qa/p0-12-w1-retest.md and tests/e2e/web/p0_12_w1_review (git show exact SHA works before merge). Tested app was71f1389 and app bytes remain identical on published af1e160. Lead bounded Astra reproduction confirms D1/ORG-3/EO-1; EO-1 is Node DOM-double evidence, not a new browser/device claim.

Priority corrections:
1. P012-D1/D3: a CONNECTED let_me_try or permission downgrade is revived by same-version reconnect or a newer snapshot lacking causal proof of that intent. S1/S1b/S1c all present full_solution; offline refusal control remains correct. Preserve connected restrictions until a causally accepted later explicit request/ack; merely changing < to <= does not address newer unrelated snapshots. Add independent intent/history-based disclosure-cap assertions; current oracle agrees with22 violations. Keep liveness with a genuinely later accepted request.
2. ORG-1/ORG-3: bind refusal to the correct problem/attempt and reject delayed cross-problem refusal; preserve possible external effect when authoritative outcome arrives without/reordered relative to local dispatch, including predispatchcancel/failure. Missing local dispatch is not proof of no exposure. Do not invent successful import from unverified claims. Add ORG-10/11 regressions for answer-bearing correction/layout/preview permission and unknown outcome never claiming everShared.
3. EO-1/EO-2: closed-root scripted activation must not become learner evidence; mark uncertainty when origin cannot be established. Reproduce on the owned browser fixture if possible before claiming browser correctness. Narrow the static guard's overstated coverage and test meaningful no-write/no-submit boundaries rather than claiming regex covers arbitrary JS; observer fixture limits and EO-3..11 remain explicit.
4. W-2: after blockers, add focused cancel-during-hash, honest pending text, older-late-result/newer-pending checks for W1c/e/f (current guards exist; coverage gap only).

Allowed paths remain module/probe/tests/docs under your ownership. P0-08 must not adopt the defective models; v0.1.0 unchanged. Use scoped tests/mutations plus necessary owned-browser checks, preserving controls and exact evidence; avoid unrelated suite reruns. Return a bounded follow-up commit with addressed IDs/unresolved items. R53/A32/A34, R51/A42 and INTENT-ANSWER-PROMPT/FAITHFUL-EXPORT + ADR0002 T1/T3 are governing sources; latest7fadd15 decisions remain. QA's preserved report contains the lower-severity follow-ons, not permission to expand into real sites or all P1 work.
